title: ampelopsis brevipedunculata var. vestita
intro: Ampelopsis brevipedunculata var. vestita, commonly known as Chinese poria, is a plant species that is also referred to as the Chinese version of the Japanese Poria species. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Chinese poria are attributed to its ability to act as a digestive aid, anti-inflammatory agent, and antioxidant, which may help to alleviate conditions such as diarrhea, dyspepsia, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Chinese poria include polysaccharides, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
